content_sections.heading: About ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker
content_sections.text: The Integrated Child Development Project (Ekikrit Bal Vikas Pariyojana) Janjgir is the project office in Janjgir-Champa, Chhattisgarh, that runs the Anganwadi centres covered by this notice. The Janpad Panchayat Nawagarh area, which includes Gram Panchayat Darri, falls under this project. The notice was published as a news item from Janjgir-Champa on the Chhattisgarh Jansampark website.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The only vacancy is at Anganwadi Kendra 01 of Gram Panchayat Darri, where the Anganwadi Worker post has fallen vacant.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Gender: Women only. Age Limit: 18 years to 44 years. Educational Qualification: 12th pass. Local residence: The Project Officer has said that any candidate of the village concerned (Gram Panchayat Darri) who has passed 12th can apply. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker
content_sections.text: Applications for the Anganwadi Worker post at Gram Panchayat Darri are made online only, at https://aww.e-bharti.in, and the last date is 31 October 2026. The notice does not describe the form-filling steps or list any documents. For more information, candidates can contact the Office of the Integrated Child Development Project Janjgir Nawagarh 2 (Karyalay Ekikrit Bal Vikas Pariyojana Janjgir Nawagarh 2).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICDS Janjgir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: ICDS Janjgir Recruitment 2026 has 1 Anganwadi Worker vacancy, at Anganwadi Kendra 01 of Gram Panchayat Darri in the Janpad Panchayat Nawagarh area.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker post is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates for the Anganwadi Worker post at Gram Panchayat Darri must have passed 12th.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Anganwadi Worker post is 18 years to 44 years.

faq.question: Q5. Can men apply for the ICDS Janjgir Anganwadi Worker post?
faq.answer: No. The notice invites applications only from women aged 18 to 44 years.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply for the Anganwadi Worker post at Gram Panchayat Darri?
faq.answer: According to the Project Officer, any candidate of the village concerned (Gram Panchayat Darri) who has passed 12th can apply. Applicants must also be women aged 18 to 44 years.
